tmp=$(mktemp -d) && cat > "$tmp/depth.py" <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, time
from sklearn.feature_selection import SelectKBest, f_classif
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score

def load(p):
    t = np.loadtxt(p, delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
    return t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]
X, y = load("data/pilot.csv")
folds = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)

# (a) interaction diagnostic: LR on pairwise products of pilot F-top12 (screen inside folds!)
from sklearn.base import BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin
class PairProd(BaseEstimator, TransformerMixin):
    def fit(self, Xx, yy=None):
        return self
    def transform(self, Xx):
        k = Xx.shape[1]; iu = np.triu_indices(k, 1)
        return np.hstack([Xx, Xx[:, iu[0]] * Xx[:, iu[1]]])
def pairpipe(k=12):
    return make_pipeline(SelectKBest(f_classif, k=k), PairProd(),
                         StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=3000))
aucs = cross_val_score(pairpipe(12), X, y, cv=folds, scoring="roc_auc")
print("(a) LR on F-top12 + pairwise products, pilot 5-fold cv:", f"{aucs.mean():.4f}", np.round(aucs,3))
aucs = cross_val_score(make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression(max_iter=3000)),
                       SelectKBest(f_classif, k=12).fit_transform(X, y), y, cv=folds, scoring="roc_auc")
print("    (leaky reference: LR on pilot-selected F-top12):", f"{aucs.mean():.4f}")

# (b) RF depth leaderboard, screen inside folds
t0 = time.time()
def pipe(k, depth, msl, mf=0.3):
    return make_pipeline(SelectKBest(f_classif, k=k),
                         RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, max_depth=depth,
                                                min_samples_leaf=msl, max_features=mf,
                                                random_state=0, n_jobs=-1))
